content.text: Hello, my kettle from ORD-1120 started leaking. Can I get a refund?
Sure, I can help with that. Could you please provide the email address you used for your Northwind Goods account?

We need to verify identity first. Ask for email. Then lookup_customer, then get order, check if order belongs to that customer, check status delivered and delivery date within 30 days. Current date 2026-06-15. Need to get order details. So first ask for email.
